capabilities: Hide sidebars automatically when a note is opened or clicked into
Reopen a hidden sidebar by pushing the mouse against the window edge
Remember and restore each sidebar's width
Pin sidebars open via a status-bar icon or command
Configure hide triggers, delays, split-editor skipping, and keyboard browsing
extras: Desktop only — mobile Obsidian already hides sidebars on note open. Width memory relies on an undocumented internal size property and may break after future Obsidian releases; only the width memory would be affected. No network requests; the plugin writes only its own settings file.
intentEvidence: Sidebar Fold hides the Obsidian sidebars when you open a note
motivation: The author browses the vault in the left sidebar and then wants it out of the way, and was reaching for the toggle every time on desktop; mobile Obsidian already folds the sidebar.
problem: On desktop, Obsidian keeps the sidebars open after you open a note, so you keep toggling them manually to get full-width reading and writing space.

relations.evidence: It works with the core file explorer and with Notebook Navigator.

summary: Sidebar manager that auto-hides the left and right sidebars when you open a note, restoring them via edge hover or a pin, and remembers their widths.
